content.title: AITWIRE vs Profound
content.intro:
AITWIRE is a vendor-neutral performance layer for AI — measuring how AI systems answer about a business, managing the approved knowledge those systems should follow, testing what changes across models and vendors, and preserving findings as evidence. AITWIRE's plan ladder runs from a free AI Readiness Assessment through Standard (monthly update cycle), Pro (weekly), and AITWIRE AI (daily), with add-on report products including the AI Answer Benchmark Report at $49/month, the AI Answer Report at $149/month, and the AI Answer Assurance Report at $499/month. The context does not show Profound offering a comparable structured update cycle, evidence-preservation layer, or tiered report product line.

Profound operates in the AI-visibility space and, based on AITWIRE's probe data, is named by AI assistants in 82% of answers across the probed engines — a meaningful presence in AI-generated responses. What Profound's product specifically does, how it is priced, and what its feature set includes are not verified in the available context and are marked accordingly below.
content.competitor_description: Profound is a company operating in the AI-visibility and AI-search category. Based on AITWIRE's probe data (11,122 probes, May–August 2026), AI assistants name Profound in 82% of answers, with 77% of those answers neutral in tone and 8% positioning Profound as recommended. What Profound's platform does, its target market, pricing structure, and specific capabilities are not verified in the available context — any such details should be confirmed directly with Profound (varies / verify).

pros: Named by AI assistants in 82% of probed answers (11,122 probes, May–August 2026), indicating strong AI-system presence
20% of answers that name Profound carry a positive tone, suggesting favourable framing in a meaningful share of AI responses
8% of positioning answers categorise Profound as recommended — above the discouraged rate of 0%

content.summary: AITWIRE offers a structured, cadence-driven measurement platform with published plan tiers, defined update frequencies (monthly at Standard, weekly at Pro, daily at AITWIRE AI), formal evidence-preservation through Assurance engagements, and three report products at published prices. Profound's product capabilities, pricing, and feature set are not verified in the available context; what is confirmed is that AI assistants named Profound in 82% of AITWIRE's probes, with predominantly neutral tone and an 8% recommended-positioning rate. Buyers whose requirements include a defined measurement cadence, sealed evidence output, or a tiered report product with a published price will find those specifics documented for AITWIRE; buyers evaluating Profound should verify its feature set, pricing, and engagement model directly with the company.
